LanguageData.MutationBloodBlade.label: blood blade
LanguageData.MutationBloodBlade.description: Colonist's hand has transformed into a long fleshy blade, which seems to live a life of its own. Upon being fed living matter in combat environment, this blade is able to produce very strong restoraive effect, capable of regenerating even permanent injuries.
LanguageData.MutationEnhancedDex.label: enhanced dexterity
LanguageData.MutationEnhancedDex.description: The radiation has strengthened the tendons and muscles in colonist's hand, making him more dexterous.
LanguageData.MutationGreenThumb.label: green thumb
LanguageData.MutationGreenThumb.description: Green growth on the surface of colonist's hand seems to invigorate any plants he puts into ground.
LanguageData.MutationHandBlade.label: hand blade
LanguageData.MutationHandBlade.description: Colonist's hand has transformed into a long blade, making it very different to do any manipulation-related tasks, but it works very well as a melee weapon.
LanguageData.MutationRippedShoulders.label: ripped shoulders
LanguageData.MutationRippedShoulders.description: Colonist's shoulders have gained a large amount of extra muscle mass, giving him extra proficiency for melee combat, as well as generally improving his looks.
LanguageData.MutationRottenHand.label: rotten hand
LanguageData.MutationRottenHand.description: Colonist's hand is near, but not exactly at a stage where it rots and falls off. Sometimes miniature life forms can be observed traversing the skin.
LanguageData.MutationShootingBoost.label: steady hand
LanguageData.MutationShootingBoost.description: A specific mutation to colonist's hand enables a much greater shooting proficiency, at cost of weakening melee attacks.
LanguageData.MutationStrengthenedArm.label: strengthened arm
LanguageData.MutationStrengthenedArm.description: The muscle tissue in the arm has mutated and grown unnaturally, causing colonist to have increased strength and control.
LanguageData.MutationTumorousHand.label: Tumorous Fingers
LanguageData.MutationTumorousHand.description: The radiation has caused benign tumours to grow on colonist's hand, destroying nerves and muscle tissue causing the hand to become crippled.
LanguageData.MutationWeakenedArm.label: Weakened Arms
LanguageData.MutationWeakenedArm.description: The radiation has caused the muscle tissue in colonist's arm to deteriorate, weakening his strength and control.
